overview: The Crimson Dunes are the heart of Scarlet Desert’s shifting sands.
details: Red dunes move unpredictably, burying ruins and exposing new ones. Sunstorms reshape the terrain daily.
hooks: A massive crimson sandstorm approaches from the east.
Buried ruins emerge from beneath the dunes.
Sun revenants gather near a newly exposed ruin.
A caravan is lost in the shifting sands.
